summary: editable-contracts preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: editable-contracts@0.0.22 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that, if Bun is not present, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, unzips it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then uses it to run the package-local file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-compiled module (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are obfuscated with a large numeric/string dictionary and a rotating shift-cipher decoder (`WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9` over `n7gIxM`), with hex-mangled identifiers. The advertised purpose of the package is a small MobX helper library, which does not require the Bun runtime or a ~700 KB opaque init bundle. Shipping the payload as a Bun-only artifact and forcing it to execute under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at preinstall is the alternate-runtime-dropper evasion pattern: the executed bytes are opaque to Node-based review, and the code runs on every `npm install` without user consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
